successors.name: Frisia
successors.text: the Frisian land east of the Lauwers, the last free Frisia, which Cliopatria redraws as its 'Frisia' row from 783 and the Franks conquered in 785

ledger.x: c. 600: the Frisian Kingdom emerges on the North Sea coast. Infobox 'Established: c. 600'; the lead says it 'emerged in the mid-7th century' and the Frisia page dates the realm 650-734, so the founding is disputed inside the pages. 602 is Cliopatria's first year.
689: Pepin of Herstal defeats Redbad at Dorestad.
719: the fighting ends in Frankish victory.
719: Charles Martel takes Frisia up to the Vlie.
734: Charles Martel wins at the Boarn.
734: the Franks take Frisia west of the Lauwers.
734: the Frisian kingship ends at the Boarn.
782: the free Frisia passes to the 'Frisia' row.

wars.name: Battle of Dorestad
wars.outcome: Frankish victory under Pepin of Herstal: Redbad cedes Frisia Citerior and Utrecht falls between 690 and 692.

wars.name: Redbad's war against Charles Martel
wars.outcome: Redbad regains southern Frisia in 714, defeats Charles Martel at Cologne in 716 and dies in 719; Charles Martel then annexes Frisia up to the Vlie.

wars.name: Battle of the Boarn
wars.outcome: Frankish victory: Poppo killed, the Franks control the Frisian lands west of the Lauwers estuary; the tribes of East Frisia stay free until 785.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line in the life of the state.
